messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "doctor may tell to stop taking for short time"
set: ["doctor may tell to stop taking for short time", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency", "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "you may need a higher dose for a short time", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "may need a lower dose or need to stop taking the medicine for a short period or for good", "stop taking", "tell doctor if taking triptans for migraine", "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant", "tell doctor if taking simvastatin", "doctor may stop the medicine", "stop taking medicine", "stop taking it", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time",
    "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency",
    "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure",
    "may need to temporarily stop taking",
    "may need a lower dose or need to stop taking the medicine for a short period or for good",
    "stop taking medicine",
    "stop taking it",
    "doctor may stop the medicine"
  ],
  "alias": "stop taking"
}
